declarations.description:
Asks the user to confirm an action before it happens. `await dialog.show()` (or the confirm helper, which
needs no markup) resolves `true` when the user confirms and `false` when they cancel, press Escape or the dialog is
closed by code. `destructive` paints the confirm button in the error colour and puts the initial focus on Cancel,
so Enter right after opening never deletes anything. Give it a `confirm-action` (`confirmAction` property) to run
the work from the dialog: the confirm button spins until it settles, and a failure keeps the dialog open for a retry.

Two opt-in modes ask for more than a click. `confirm-text` is a typed confirmation: the confirm button stays disabled
until the user types that phrase (a repository's name) into the field the dialog adds. `prompt()` (or the
prompt helper) asks for a value: it opens the dialog with a text field, or the control in the `input` slot,
and resolves with its value, or `null` when cancelled. The control's own constraints (`required`, `type`) and the
prompt's `validate` function are checked on confirm; an error keeps the dialog open with the message under the
input. Enter in a text input confirms.

The dialog is a `c2-modal` announced as an `alertdialog` described by its message: a click on the backdrop does not
close it, Escape cancels it. Restyle the frame through the `--c2-modal…` variables, which reach the inner modal.

members.name: open
members.description: Open state. Setting it shows the dialog; clearing it closes the dialog as a cancel.

members.name: heading
members.description: Heading text, when the `heading` slot is empty.

members.name: message
members.description: Message text, when the default slot is empty.

members.name: confirmLabel
members.description: Label of the button that confirms. Defaults to "Confirm" in the nearest `lang` (English, or a language the app adds).

members.name: cancelLabel
members.description: Label of the button that cancels. Defaults to "Cancel" in the nearest `lang`.

members.name: destructive
members.description: The action cannot be undone: error-coloured confirm button, and the initial focus goes to Cancel.

members.name: confirmText
members.description:
Phrase the user must type before the confirm button enables, such as the name of what is deleted. Adds a field under
the message, which takes the initial focus. The comparison is exact, ignoring spaces at either end.

members.name: inputLabel
members.description: Name and visible label of the control in the `input` slot, or of the built-in prompt field. Defaults to the heading.

members.name: confirmAction
members.description:
Work to run when the user confirms. While its promise is pending the confirm button spins and the dialog cannot be
dismissed; it closes as confirmed when the promise resolves and stays open (firing `confirm-error`) when it rejects.

type.text: { promise: Promise<boolean>; resolve: (confirmed: boolean) => void } | undefined

members.name: prompting
members.description: The running `prompt()`'s options; kept until the next opening, so the field stays while the dialog closes.

members.name: confirmedValue
members.description: The value that passed validation when the user confirmed; what `prompt()` resolves with.

members.name: question
members.description: Counts the openings, so work started for one question does not act on the next.

members.name: fields
members.description: The typed confirmation and the prompt, loaded the first time this dialog needs them.

members.name: show
members.description: Opens the dialog and resolves with the answer: `true` when confirmed, `false` otherwise.

members.name: prompt
members.description:
Opens the dialog as a prompt and resolves with its input's value when the user confirms, `null` otherwise. The input
is the control in the `input` slot, else a built-in text field set up by `options`.

```ts
const name = await dialog.prompt({ label: 'File name', value: file.name, required: true })
```

members.name: close
members.description: Closes the dialog with the given answer (`false` by default).

members.name: loadFields
members.description: Loads the typed confirmation and the prompt (with the text field) when this dialog uses one of them.

events.name: cancel
events.description: Fired when the dialog is dismissed without confirming: Cancel, Escape or `close(false)`.

events.name: close
events.description: Fired after the dialog has closed; `detail.confirmed` is the answer `show()` resolves with.

events.name: confirm
events.description: Cancelable: fired when the user confirms, after the input is validated and before the action runs and the dialog closes; `preventDefault()` keeps it open.

events.name: confirm-error
events.description: Fired when `confirmAction` or a prompt's `validate` throws or rejects; the dialog stays open.
Fired after the dialog has been shown.

declarations.name: confirm
declarations.description:
Asks for confirmation without any markup: mounts a temporary `c2-confirm-dialog`, opens it and resolves with the
answer, then removes the dialog once its closing transition has finished.

```ts
if (await confirm({ heading: 'Delete project?', message: 'This cannot be undone.', confirmLabel: 'Delete', destructive: true })) remove()
```
